scientific_integrity: Exhaustiveness is symbolic: positivity reduces the smaller odd prime to \(3\) or \(5\), and the remaining divisor-sum cases are closed exactly. The bounded computational replay is only a regression check.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only squarefree integers of the form \(2pq\) with odd primes \(p<q\). It does not classify nonsquarefree three-prime-support 2-near-perfect numbers.
title: Squarefree \(2\)-near-perfect numbers with three prime factors
